intro: Plush comfort or firm support - the Restomagic Dual let's you choose. The dual-sided mattress allows for with two firmness levels, so whatever your needs, you wake up rested and ready for the day.

features.title: Comfort on both sides, your way
features.text: Crave flexibility? Our dual-sided mattress lets you pick between plush comfort and firm support—so your bed adjusts to you.

features.title: Stay cool with breathable fabric comfort
features.text: Stay cool and comfortable! High-quality grey and white knitted fabric allows for better airflow, keeping your mattress fresh through the night.

features.title: Soft quilting adds an extra layer of comfort
features.text: Your bed should welcome you the moment you lie down, and our plush quilted top does exactly that, offering soft, breathable comfort that helps you unwind with ease.

features.title: Firm support for a healthy spine
features.text: A high density support foam layer ensures firm spinal alignment, reducing aches and enhancing posture during your sleep.

features.title: Stay reassured with our 5 year warranty
features.text: Rest easy with the assurance of a 5-year warranty. Crafted for durability and reliability, this mattress is backed by our commitment to quality, ensuring years of unmatched comfort and peace of mind.

features.title: Sized to suit any space comfortably
features.text: Your bed, your rules. Our versatile range of sizes ensures a perfect fit for any frame, blending comfort and practicality to enhance your every night.

name: Restomagic Dual Comfort Queen Bed Foam Mattress 75 X 60 X 8 Inches
